startup_observation.cache_boundary: First final-launcher invocation in the fresh OS/installer state. Resources were already transferred over emulated USB; host and OS caches were not flushed. This is not physical cold boot.
startup_observation.policy: Full FNV and startup structural validation remain enabled. Common SHA labels alone are metadata comparisons. Existing lazy checks do not independently cover all retained LZ4, text and glyph bytes. Sequential-read reuse is evaluated follow-up work, not an implemented speedup or a disabled-validation decision.
